question: Wp-E3 found the integrated stress response the most downward-shifted of fifteen programmes under EGCG in Th17n, and serine/one-carbon also falling. The two declared sets share members, because canonical ATF4 targets include serine-pathway enzymes. Does either shift survive removing the shared genes?
decision: Whether the Wp-E3 stress result may be used as evidence about cellular stress in the Wp-P02 branch card, or must instead be recorded there as a restatement of the serine-pathway decrease already reported by Wp-R3.
strongest_rival: The two results are one result. A small number of genes belonging to both lists - ATF4 targets that are also serine enzymes - carry both medians, so 'the stress response falls' and 'serine synthesis falls' are the same observation counted twice.
discriminator: Recompute both programmes with the intersection removed, under Wp-E3's construction unchanged: same frozen input tables, same global-shift base, same seed, same 1,000 draws, same expression-decile null. The shared genes are additionally scored alone. If the reduced ISR set stays outside its expression-matched null in the same direction, the shift is not carried by the shared members; if it does not, it is.
exposure_record: The full-set values are exposed: Wp-E3's integrated-stress-response and serine/one-carbon shifts are read and reported in E3_RESULTS.md, and the Wp-E3 contract already disclosed the overlap under nesting_and_overlap, naming MTHFD2 and SHMT2. The reduced-set values, the shared-genes-only values and their nulls are not exposed: no variant of this computation has been executed, inside or outside the governed runner, and the stop rule below was written before any reduced-set value existed. The shared gene list is not hardcoded in the entrypoint; it is computed from the Wp-E3 membership table, so the contract does not depend on the overlap being the two genes the Wp-E3 contract happened to name.
biological_unit: Library. GSE290297 declares no animal field.
nesting_and_overlap: Every quantity comes from the same frozen contrast table as Wp-E3, so this is not independent evidence and cannot confirm Wp-E3 - it can only establish which genes carry a value Wp-E3 already reported. Removing shared members makes the two lists disjoint; it does not make the programmes biologically independent, because ATF4 output and serine synthesis are coupled in the biology as well as in the lists.
population_and_selection: The two Wp-E3 programmes as that run actually scored them, read from its committed membership table rather than re-derived, in all four division-1 arms. No gene is selected by its fold change.
contrast: Median centred log2 fold change of each variant - ISR full, ISR minus shared, serine full, serine minus shared, shared genes alone - in each of the four division-1 arms.
endpoint: Per variant and arm: centred median, expression-matched null interval and empirical p, set median AveExpr, and the global-shift base. Plus every member gene's log2 fold change, centred value, AveExpr and adjusted p, so each median can be checked by hand.
methods: Wp-E3's construction, unchanged and re-executed rather than re-derived: global shift is the median of genes in neither pathogenicity group; the null is 1,000 draws at seed 20261005 matching the set's own AveExpr-decile composition over ten deciles. The run asserts that the full-set variants reproduce the Wp-E3 values to within 1e-12 and fails if they do not, so a recomputation error cannot be mistaken for a sensitivity result.
missingness_and_exclusions: Genes absent from an arm's fitted universe are dropped from that arm and the mapped count is reported.
multiplicity: Each variant is tested against its own matched null. This is a decomposition of one reported value, not a family of hypotheses, and no conclusion rests on an empirical p near 0.05.
precision_basis: Five libraries per arm with no animal field; empirical p values describe the gene-set draw, not sampling of mice.
interpretation_limit: Library-level descriptive readout of frozen tables on deposited TPM, so no animal-level or causal inference, and no independence from Wp-E3. Transcript abundance of ISR target genes is a downstream proxy for a response set by eIF2-alpha phosphorylation and ATF4 translation, so nothing here measures stress-response activity. A surviving shift licenses the observation as a transcript-level association only.
stop_rule: Report all five variants in all four arms whichever way the focal result falls. If the Th17n EGCG ISR shift does not remain outside its expression-matched null in the same direction after the shared genes are removed, the ISR observation does not enter the Wp-P02 card as evidence about cellular stress and the card records that it is carried by the serine-pathway members instead. Do not redefine a set, change the null or add an arm after seeing a value.
amendment_reason: Discharges the overlap limitation the Wp-E3 contract disclosed but did not resolve, because the Wp-P02 card now depends on which genes carry the stress shift.
